answer: Age every trust edge: a new identity's attest links start worthless and gain weight only after surviving 6 epochs undisputed, full weight at 12; any dispute or transfer resets the edge to zero. A prism check splits each edge set by age and counts only edges older than 6 epochs, so a farm minting 1,000 clones must grow 5,000 separate edges through 6 epochs of real time — aging cannot be bought, copied, or run in parallel, since an edge's age is bound to its own creation record. The nectar of paid seats flows only to identities whose beacon of aged edges is unbroken.
